regime_context: The consensus reads Warsh as a straightforward hawk, but revealed preference is inflation-mandate credibility first and labor-crack second — this is sequencing, not terminal tightening, and the setup arguably pre-loads a post-midterm pivot. The administration's real interest is the yield outcome, not the hawkish optics, so the tradable bias is front-end carry and strategic-capacity equities rather than a simple dollar-long.
regime_context_zh: 市场共识把沃什解读为单纯的鹰派，但显露出的偏好是通胀使命信誉优先、就业裂缝其次——这是排序，不是终局加息，而且这一姿态本质上是在为中期选举后的转向预埋伏笔。政府的真实利益是收益率结果而非鹰派表象，因此可交易的偏向是短端票息和战略产能股票，而不是简单的做多美元。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse (7/8) realized the oil-spike tail, and energy was already the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 on conflict rotation; Brent's spike toward ~$80 re-primes the rotation even as headline fragility keeps conviction modest.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂（7/8）兑现了油价上行的尾部风险，而能源板块本已是第一季度受冲突轮动推动的ETF流入榜首；布伦特原油飙升至约80美元重新点燃了这一轮动，尽管头条消息的脆弱性使确信度保持温和。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED as of 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict
Recent XLE overweight call hit (+0.056 on 11/03, +0.07 on 10/23)
theses.dissent: A rapid Iran de-escalation would unwind the conflict premium; XLE is headline-fragile and the re-escalation is already partially priced.
theses.dissent_zh: 如果伊朗局势快速降级，冲突溢价将被解除；XLE对头条消息高度敏感，且再升级已部分反映在价格中。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the 42-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在42天检验日之前，XLE落后SPY达5%

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's revealed preference is inflation-mandate first — hot May PCE (core +3.4% y/y, highest since Oct-2023) plus his Sintra refusal to signal July keeps the hawkish line intact, with >70% market probability of a September HIKE; long-duration Treasuries face a stagflationary split where oil is an upside price shock and the Fed is not yet easing.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什显露出的偏好是通胀使命优先——5月PCE偏热（核心同比+3.4%，为2023年10月以来最高），加上他在辛特拉拒绝暗示7月行动，鹰派立场得以维持，市场对9月加息的概率超过70%；在滞胀分裂格局下，石油是上行的价格冲击，而美联储尚未转向宽松，长久期美债承压。
evidence: May PCE core +3.4% y/y, headline +4.1% y/y (6/25)
July 7/13: CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike
Warsh Sintra: 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July
theses.dissent: A widening labor crack (June payrolls +57k, participation 4-yr low) is exactly the catalyst that reopens the easing path; a data-driven September pivot would flip TLT.
theses.dissent_zh: 就业裂缝扩大（6月非农仅+5.7万，劳动参与率创4年新低）正是重新打开宽松路径的催化剂；9月若出现数据驱动的转向，TLT将反转。

falsifier.text: TLT beats SPY by 3% before the 63-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在63天检验日之前，TLT跑赢SPY达3%

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: The dollar has fallen well off its 13-month high (DXY ~100.9) while gold holds a $4,044–4,200 range in a stagflationary split — an upside oil shock plus hike-majority pricing is exactly the macro mix that historically re-ignites gold's real-asset bid even as the administration suppresses front-end yields.
theses.thesis_zh: 美元已从13个月高点大幅回落（DXY约100.9），而黄金在滞胀分裂格局中守住4044至4200美元区间——油价上行冲击叠加市场多数预期加息，正是历史上重新点燃黄金实物资产买盘的宏观组合，即使政府在压制短端收益率。
evidence: Stagflationary split: Brent spiked ~$80 + >70% Sept hike probability
theses.dissent: Warsh's discipline re-anchors real yields higher (real 10y was 2.29% as of 6/16), which is the strongest headwind to gold.
theses.dissent_zh: 沃什的纪律立场重新锚定更高的实际收益率（6月16日时10年期实际利率为2.29%），这是黄金最强的逆风。

falsifier.text: GLD lags SPY by 5% before the 63-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在63天检验日之前，GLD落后SPY达5%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The China tariff-regime TRANSITION keeps the onshoring bid in play: the SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection premium, and the Section 301 handoff (~12.5% replacement) plus the 25% advanced-chip tariff staying in force sustains the domestic-fab premium even with a truce relieving rare-earth supply.
theses.thesis_zh: 中国关税体制的过渡阶段使本土化买盘得以延续：最高法院裁决并未解除关税保护溢价，而第301条款的接续（约12.5%的替代税率）加上25%的先进芯片关税继续生效，即使停火缓解了稀土供应，国内晶圆厂溢价仍然存在。
evidence: China -- tech war theater: SCOTUS strike-down did NOT unwind tariff-protection premium
Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending; 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force (open prediction)
Re-verify China effective tariff rate after July 24
theses.dissent: A clean Section 301 handoff failure or a broader tech-truce with China would strip the tariff premium; the recent SMH call missed (-0.261).
theses.dissent_zh: 若第301条款接续失败或中美出现更广泛的科技休战，关税溢价将被剥离；此前SMH看多判断已失利（-0.261）。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the 42-day check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: 在42天检验日之前，SMH落后SPY达5%
